en: An old Russian Empire postal card with printed red coat of arms on the left and pre-printed red postage on the upper right, heavily canceled with circular postmarks dated 6 4 05. The heading in red Cyrillic reads "ОТКРЫТОЕ ПИСЬМО" (open letter / postcard). The card is filled with handwritten script in black ink, addressed in German. At the bottom left is a purple business stamp in German giving the address of a bookseller in Riga, with additional small red printed Russian text along the bottom.
